description:
Detects adversarial embedding vectors inserted into ChromaDB collections

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_chroma_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%chromadb%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%embedding%') AND "value" > 0
dataSourceDetails.originalQuery: SELECT "siem_general_db_chroma_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%chromadb%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%embedding%') AND "value" > 0
